name: Shirakoma Kumi
source:
Born on November 3, 1989.
Member of the Tennis club. Has distinctive short twintails. Her hobby is writing poetry, and she dreams of being a poet and columnist. She is good friends with [url=/c136094]Amaike Mami[/url] and [url=/c136096]Natsusawa Remi[/url], often seen hanging out together.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
